name: Henrietta Roses
original_name: アンリエッタ・ローゼス
source:
"[url=/c135123]Sreng Ileach[/url]! Just you wait......! 

Henrietta is a student at the magic academy and the daughter of [url=/c135513]Archbishop Mira[/url], boasting a noble lineage tied to the royal family. Though she goes way back with [url=/c135126]Princess Fine[/url], Henrietta keeps her at arm's length these days. While she can be a stickler for rules and somewhat inflexible, Henrietta has a heart of gold.

She's a top-notch student, widely favored to win the academy's dueling tournament. This victory would have qualified her to become Lia's new partner, a prestigious position. However, her dreams were dashed when Sreng crashed the party and snatched the qualification from under her nose. Henrietta has since harbored a grudge against Sreng, constantly finding ways to butt heads with him.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.ensemble-game.com/30.kyokumari/character_09_henrietta.html]official website[/url]]
